# o-md reference

Generated from o-md's catalog: every declared setting with its default and every default key row, without a user's configuration. The fingerprint in the header is the match key: the running binary shows its own in the docs viewer (`:docs open index`), and equal fingerprints mean these pages describe that build exactly.

| Topic | Page | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `settings` | [settings.md](settings.md) | 212 settings: name, type, default, allowed values, section, who declares it, description |
| `bindings` | [bindings.md](bindings.md) | 773 default key rows in 76 tables, by noun and mode |
| `standard-verbs` | [standard-verbs.md](standard-verbs.md) | the 23 standard verbs and what each needs; 25 nouns with props: kind, props, verbs |

In the app, `docs open TOPIC` (`:help TOPIC`, `:h TOPIC`) shows a page with the user's own values and rows marked `yours:` (setting `docs.show-config`).
